path.data-description: the recess the C14 sits back inside. The CONNECTOR is std/c14-inlet@1, composed rather than drawn - see `inlet` in provenance.

rect.data-description: The translucent handle, lit from within. ISM table 12 entire: green - a valid source is connected and the supply is operational; blinking amber - a problem with the supply; not illuminated - no power connected; blinking green - firmware is being updated. `mismatch` IS WHY THE SEQUENCE MECHANISM EXISTS, for the fourth time on this chassis: Dell's wording is "the PSU handle blinks green five times at a rate of 4 Hz and turns off", which gives the phase length exactly - 4 Hz is 0.125 s lit and 0.125 s dark - and then a dark tail that the article does not time. The five blinks and their rate are Dell's; the 2 second tail is this library's reading of "and turns off". NO RATE IS PUBLISHED for the amber fault or the firmware blink, so 1 Hz is a reading and not a figure - unlike the mismatch, where 4 Hz is stated.
